implementation.resource_registry: Allocation-free fixed-capacity registrations cover rigid, liquid, cloth, soft-body, rope, particle-smoke and grid-smoke families, including shared smoke-slot admission.
implementation.atomic_boundary: Allocation, overflow, unsupported execution and pre-commit failures abort spatial, snapshot and resource staging together without publishing state, consuming capacities or advancing the clock.
implementation.generation_ownership: Registrations identify owner slots and generations; reset and replacement invalidate staged ownership before capacity reuse.
implementation.spatial_ownership: Every family stages against one common spatial allocation and exactly one publication token. The fixed schedule performs no intra-tick host readback or global device wait.
implementation.binding_contract: docs/roadmap/F8-39-COMMON-STAGING.md assigns concrete boundary, predict, spatial, domain, coupling, lifecycle, output and commit ownership to F8-40 through F8-49.
implementation.unsupported_execution: Only rigid operators are executable at F8-39. Live liquid, cloth, soft-body, rope, particle-smoke and grid-smoke resources are admitted, then return PM_ERROR_FEATURE_NOT_PRESENT before device work until F8-40 through F8-44 bind their operators.
